scripts.build:wasm: command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oj www needs wasm-pack (cargo install wasm-pack) and the wasm32-unknown-unknown target (rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown)'; exit 1; }; wasm-pack build ../crates/oj_wasm --release --target web --no-typescript --no-pack --out-dir ../../www/public/oj-wasm && rm -f public/oj-wasm/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:dev: if command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1; then wasm-pack build ../crates/oj_wasm --dev --target web --no-typescript --no-pack --out-dir ../../www/public/oj-wasm && rm -f public/oj-wasm/.gitignore; elif [ -f public/oj-wasm/oj_wasm.js ]; then echo 'wasm-pack missing; serving the existing public/oj-wasm bundle'; else echo 'oj www needs wasm-pack (cargo install wasm-pack) and the wasm32-unknown-unknown target (rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown)'; exit 1; fi
